name: Dashboard celestial-navigation palette (#1148)
notes: Accessibility rule marvin#1062: text ≥4.5:1, large text ≥3:1, pixel (thin fonts) ≥7:1; color never alone. Dash background #0f1117 is the boot sequence; bg #05040A is marvin show windows. The raster texture (#ffffff07 on 1px of 3px height) sits on both.

pairs.notes: Dashboard/show-window body text (.show-empty, .show-history-meta, .show-tag); 10–12px. Needs 'text' (4.5:1) because these are read normally, not at pixel-art density.
Raster sits on .show-root/.show-hud; .show-tag sits on this. Same text level since the raster texture is felt, not read.
Boot sequence body labels (.boot-hdr, .boot-bar .boot-lbl); 11px. Same contrast level as the main background.
Raster texture over boot's dark background; worst-case for visibility.
.show-label (14px), .show-btn (11px), .show-card-url (13px): main UI text that's read normally, not pixel-density.
.boot-title h1 is 60px (large) but other greens are UI accents (<18pt): classifying at 'text' (4.5:1) covers all uses.
Boot sequence uses green for ok states and smaller UI accents; classified at 'text' (4.5:1) for safety since not all uses are 18pt+.
.show-project (11px) and .boot-title .boot-sub (13px) are <18pt regular; classified at 'text' (4.5:1) per font size, not semantic use.
Boot subtitle (13px) and smaller status text are <18pt; classified at 'text' (4.5:1) for consistent coverage across both backgrounds.
.show-reason, .show-notice (10–12px): error/warning text that must be clear but are shorter spans.
Boot sequence error states (banner, text); same contrast level as other boot text.
Default text color for .show-root; fallback for items and labels where no accent color is set.
Moon is the boot's lighter alternate text; same level across both backgrounds.
